Desktop Platform view, sandboxed account preload, IPC names, and client metadata
from DeepSeek Harness `39163dd30f703a79079e2d2446545cff3c453738`.

Imports of the deepseek-account package point to the adjacent upstream metadata
functions and the host's equivalent type definitions. A document observer gives
KWork its load and crash status before the native child is presented.
The wrapper owns process IPC and Windows embedding; it must not bypass the
upstream navigation, bootstrap identity, storage cleanup, or header policies.

Electron is pinned to 44.7.0, the baseline required by that desktop snapshot.
The helper is only for account Platform pages. KWork's primary UI stays in GPUI.
See LICENSE for the upstream MIT terms.
